select PID, REL_ID, REL_TYPE, REL_NAME, REL_NUMBER, TRADE_ORG, TRAN_TYPE, BUS_TYPE, DATA_SOURCES, TRAN_DATE, MAJOR_TRADE, CALIBER, STATUS, STATUS_COMMENT, TOTOL_TRADE_AMOUNT, CONTRACT_NO, TRADE_AMOUNT, BUS_START_TIME, BUS_END_TIME, TRADE_OCCUR, TRADE_PRICE, PRICING_POLICY, TRADE_SUBJECT, REMARK, IS_EFFECTIVE, APPROVE_TRADE_AMOUNT, TRANS_NUM, TENANT_ID_, CREATED_BY_ID_, CREATED_BY_NAME_, CREATED_TIME_, DELFLAG_, DISPLAY_ORDER_, MODIFIED_BY_ID_, MODIFIED_BY_NAME_, MODIFIED_TIME_, VERSION_, UNITF_TRADE_AGREMENT_BUSINESS, IS_DEAL_PRICE, consider_type, is_HoldingSubsidiary, HoldingSubsidiary_name, HoldingSubsidiary_number, totalAssets, Financial_Impact, Tra_sub_Name, Major_Type, Contract_Amount, HoldingSubsidiary_type, IS_CASH_SUBSCRIBE, AMEND_ID, AMEND_NAME, IS_ACCUMULATED, CONTRACT_NAME, tran_name, tran_opponent, cert_type, actual_total, contract_Total, contract_date, rel_info_list_str, rel_trade_amount from ins_tra_other where consider_type = '2' AND STATUS = '3' AND prac_trade_amount IS NOT NULL AND DELFLAG_ = '1'
AND CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.year}
AND (CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.begin} or CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.center} or CREATED_TIME_ like #{param.end})
order by CREATED_TIME_ desc

from ins_tra_other where 1=1 and PRAC_TRADE_AMOUNT IS null
